text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the pod runs only from VSYS (4.4 V on USB, cell voltage on battery).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: PWR_EN comes from the puck's slide switch; R7 holds the LDO off.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: GPIO8 is a strapping pin: the LED pulls it high, R3 makes sure.

svg.text: VCELL feeds the OLED supply switch on sheet P-2.
